title: The adjunction unit of a fully faithful left adjoint is invertible
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be categories and $L:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, $R:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ a specified adjunction $L\dashv R$ with unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal A}\to RL$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. If $L$ is fully faithful, meaning that $L:\operatorname{Hom}(A,A')\to\operatorname{Hom}(LA,LA')$ is bijective for every pair of objects, then $\eta$ is a natural isomorphism.
